content.comment_body: Sales and delivery release for the new firmware [version_no] for [product_name] ([article_no]) including download. Applies to related products. The firmware [version_no] for these modules is now officially available as a free download, and new units will be shipped with this updated firmware beginning 03/2021. This firmware replaces the previous version and features expanded functions to support communication between [product_name] modules and [product_name] base hardware with the latest [version_no]. It also offers general improvements and optimizations. The update is required for customers using [product_name] monitoring/control with the new [version_no]. Due to an important security change, encrypted connections are now mandatory for process data exchange. This is supported in the new firmware, with guidance available on parallel access and SMS command usage in the updated manual. Additional improvements with the new firmware include: - Process communication: [product_name] modules can now be started or stopped via the web interface; connections and assignments are not active when stopped. - SMS status functions: Newly introduced SMS commands allow users to check and change device operating status. - ECC: Enhanced SSL encryption performance through ECC cryptography. - SMS: Correction of sporadic sending errors caused by AT + CRES settings, especially for certain SIM card types. - GPS: Negative altitude values are now displayed correctly. - Web access: User-defined websites hosted on the base module are accessible through [product_name] modules without restrictions when paired with compatible hardware and software versions. Please note limitations for hardware and firmware versions prior to the newest release; refer to [document] for details. Currently, only the link to the German information site is available.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion highlights the release of new firmware for [product_name] modules, detailing expanded functionality, improved security—including mandatory encrypted communication with updated base hardware—and new features such as SMS status management, faster encryption via ECC, and bug fixes. Unrestricted website access and ongoing limitations for users with older hardware are explained, directing users to official documentation for complete information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate the firmware update to deliver stronger security, better compatibility with newer [product_name] hardware, expanded management options, and corrections for previously reported issues.
